entities.summary: Robert Edward "Bud" Cramer Jr. is an American politician who was a Democratic member of the United States House of Representatives from 1991 to 2009, representing Alabama's 5th congressional district. On March 13, 2008, Cramer announced he would not seek re-election to a 10th term.
